run_create_tart_train_data: run the script to create TART full train and dev JSON datasets from input JSONL files
process_data_positive_negative: process input data to create positive and negative labeled query document pairs with prompts
process_instruction_unfollowing_sample: process instruction unfollowing samples by sampling contexts and creating negative labeled training data
load_data_json_lines: load JSON line-delimited data files and return a list of parsed JSON objects
process_prompts_from_row: extract prompt columns from a data row and return a list of prompt strings
